# Support Desk Working Notes: Marlowe & Pine

## Tools / workflow (desk.py)
- Actions: `verify`, `refund`, `credit`, `set-email`, `tag`, `escalate <case> <team>`, `close`. Data: actions.jsonl, cases.json, customers.json, orders.json. Replies go to `outbox/<case>.md`.
- Order records hold total, shipping, refunded, carrier, tracking, delivered/estimated date and items. Check them before acting.
- Customer records hold email, **locale**, tier and credit_balance. Reply in the customer's locale: en-US English; es-MX Spanish; fr French; de-DE German (formal "Sie"); pt-BR Brazilian Portuguese. The two sign-off lines stay in English.
- `verify` the customer against **every** order cited, including info-only or account-only requests.
- Step order: verify, then actions (refund/credit/escalate/set-email), then reply, then tag, then close. Handle every request in a multi-issue ticket within the same case.
- `set-email` runs on the customer record. Confirm the new address in the reply.

## Tagging (HARD RULE)
- Each case gets exactly **one** tag before close: `billing`, `shipping`, `product`, `account` or `other`. Any other label, two tags or no tag breaks reporting.
- In a multi-issue ticket, tag the primary issue, meaning the one that needs action or escalation. A refund or finance escalation is `billing`, including damaged-item refunds and when an email change is also requested. A late or in-transit order with credit is `shipping`.

## Refund authority (HARD RULE)
- Refund **$40 or less** directly. A missing item at $30 with no prior refunds is fine to refund.
- For **over $40**, never `refund`. Run `escalate <case> finance-ops` instead (`billing-review` is retired). The note covers:
  - the issue and the item (name, size or "no size listed", price, qty)
  - the amount requested, order total and shipping, carrier and delivery date, prior refunds
  - "Credit given: $X" or "No credit given", then "Over $40 limit"
- This also applies to damaged, wrong-item, wrong-colour and wrong-size requests.
- For an escalation, the reply says finance will review and follow up. Promise no amount, timing or outcome. Give no return or reorder instructions.
- Count prior refunds on the order. When in doubt, escalate.

## Goodwill credit (HARD RULE)
- Inconvenience credit is **capped at $15 per case** for every tier, even when the customer demands more. Giving $15 or less without escalating is approved.
- Credit is optional alongside a finance escalation. Late orders and damaged items are good fits.
- Mention only the credit actually given, never the amount the customer asked for. Apologize warmly instead.

## Shipping / delivery (HARD RULE)
- **Never state a delivery date, ETA or number of days.** That includes the carrier's estimate from the order record and any "follow up if it's not here by X" date.
